title: White Rabbit Vigenere
description:
A fictional cryptography lab intercepted a message protected with a repeating-key Vigenere cipher. The key is `CAT`.

Ciphertext:
```
hoenop vhx yhbve kcbukt
```

Spaces are preserved for readability but are not part of the encryption.
objective: Recover the plaintext and submit it as HC{plaintext_with_underscores} (lowercase, spaces replaced by underscores).

hints.text: Subtract the repeating key letters (C=2, A=0, T=19) from each ciphertext letter.
